title: Child Nutrition
before:
A hungry child cannot learn. The Maine Department of Education Child Nutrition is proud to support several federal programs for the health and well-being of Maine's children and youth. Each of these programs helps fight hunger and obesity by reimbursing organizations such as schools, childcare centers, and after-school programs for providing healthy meals to children. Resources for school food service professionals as well as access to guidance and regulatory information are provided here to support these programs. Child Nutrition oversees several United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) Food and Nutrition Services programs and initiatives that provide healthy food to children.

notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Tag a document link with the format it opens
decisions.why: 4 links on this page open a file — 4 PDF — and say nothing about it, while others in the same list carry a tag because their author typed one. The format is read from the file name, so the list stops being half-labelled. No link text changes.

decisions.label: Draw a closing link as the action it is
decisions.why: 1 passage ends with a paragraph holding nothing but a link — the thing the passage was leading up to. Set as running text it looks like any other link in the sentence above it. The site already has one way of drawing an action, so it takes that. The words do not change.

decisions.label: Remove the first section header
decisions.why: "Child Nutrition Resources" repeats the page title, so the reader is told the same thing twice before any content.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
